LESSON: USING OUR SENSES TO IDENTIFY FOOD

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Foods
Topic 3.3: Using our senses to identify food

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Using our senses to identify food. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify common foods in the locality,
2. look at, taste, touch and smell some selected foods for fun,
3. appreciate different foods in the locality irrespective of color, taste, touch and smell. foods available in the locality using different computing devices and display in class. 149 computing devices Core-Competence to be developed Critical thinking, Creativity and Imagination, Digital literacy

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Using our senses to identify food.
2. Explain Using our senses to identify food to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Using our senses to identify food.
4. Show that you can: identify common foods in the locality,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Using our senses to identify food. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Using our senses to identify food important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER
